newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT - ING starts Alfa as hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - ING starts Alfa as hold.

text.p: ING Barings said on Tuesday it had started coverage of Mexican holding company, Alfa SA as a hold.
-- "Alfa outperformed the Mexican index by 12.2 percent in the first part of 1997, but it is unlikely to outperform the market in the next 12 months," wrote analyst Daniel Goldstein.
-- The low rating was based on valuation and low expected sales growth, ING said.
-- "Alfa is facing an environment of price pressures in its main business -- petrochemicals and steel -- that will prevent them from growing significantly through 1998," he wrote.
-- Alfa was trading down 30 centavos at 44.60 pesos in early trade.
